title: Lu–Wenzel eigenvalue conjecture
statement:
Let $T_X:M(n,\mathbb{C})\to M(n,\mathbb{C})$ be defined by $T_X(Y)=[X^*,[X,Y]]$, and let $\lambda_1(T_X)\geq\cdots\geq\lambda_N(T_X)$ be its eigenvalues. **Lu–Wenzel eigenvalue conjecture.** For $X\in M(n,\mathbb{K})$ with $\|X\|=1$,

$$
\lambda_1(T_X)+\lambda_3(T_X)\leq 3.
$$

The supplied text identifies this as a Lu–Wenzel conjecture and says it implies a bound for the case $k=2$ of the related eigenvalue question; no resolution is stated.
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2019–2024). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1908.06624](https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.06624).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01085

Status: **open** according to the source (as of February 2024). “They started with the following Conjectures , , and an open Question in the space $M(n, \mathbb{K})$ of $n\times n$ matrices over the field $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$.”
source_name: Jianquan Ge, Fagui Li, Zizhou Tang and Yi Zhou, “A survey on the DDVV-type inequalities”, arXiv:2402.01085 (2024).
